name: My Succubus Companion
description: Single-companion raising simulator for My Succubus Companion in Thalorim: tracks 5 monotone evolution stages, 10 weighted routes (locking at Defined), mucosal vitality drain × protection matrix, time decay, daily neglect checks, and approved stage portraits.
toolDescription: Update or inspect My Succubus Companion state (naming, rules, protection, mucosal contact drain, feeding, training, comfort, evolution, day rollover, and {{user}} vitality recovery) during natural RP when no !succubus command ran pre-turn.

toolActions.name: set_name
toolActions.description: Record the name given to or chosen by the companion.

toolActions.name: set_rule
toolActions.description: Add a household rule or feeding boundary.

toolActions.name: protection
toolActions.description: Set the active anti-drain protection method before or during contact.

toolActions.name: contact
toolActions.description: Resolve mucosal contact vitality absorption and user vitality drain.

toolActions.name: feed
toolActions.description: Feed the companion from affection, praise, dream, magic, admiration, offered vitality, or ordinary food.

toolActions.name: train
toolActions.description: Train a personality, discipline, or route-shaping stat.

toolActions.name: comfort
toolActions.description: Offer shelter, warmth, reassurance, or emotional comfort.

toolActions.name: evolve
toolActions.description: Advance to the next evolution milestone when triggered by story/ritual progression.

toolActions.name: pass_day
toolActions.description: Advance one in-world day and evaluate care vs neglect tracking.

params.name: neglected
params.description: Whether she was neglected that day

toolActions.name: recover_vitality
toolActions.description: Restore {{user}} mortal vitality after resting, eating a meal, sleeping, or receiving healing/potions.

params.name: amount
params.description: Optional explicit vitality recovery amount from 1 to 100

toolActions.name: status
toolActions.description: Inspect full current companion stats, route lean/lock, intimacy profile, and HUD summary.

gmPrompt:
<succubus_companion>
- [SUCCUBUS_COMPANION] in the State Memo is maintained deterministically by script. NEVER invent stat totals, override her Stage/Route/Mood/Need, or regress her stage.
- When the user writes natural prose (naming her, setting a household rule, comforting, feeding via affection/praise/dreams/magic/vitality/food, training habits, mucosal contact/kissing, changing protection, passing a day, or {{user}} resting/eating/sleeping/healing to recover mortal vitality) WITHOUT a `!succubus` command, call `Script_SuccubusCompanion` mid-turn so the script calculates exact vitality drain, stat shifts, route lean/lock, and stage evolution and returns immediate guidance.
- If `[SCRIPT_EVENT]` states a `!succubus` command already ran pre-turn, do NOT re-call `Script_SuccubusCompanion` for it — simply narrate the outcome faithfully.
- When `[SCRIPT_EVENT]` or a tool result signals a stage transition (Awakened -> Imprinted -> Shaped -> Defined -> Ascendant), narrate the visible shift in horns, wings, tail, aura, posture, and voice naturally without mentioning system or script terms aloud.
- She is a succubus, not a vampire: never frame her hunger as blood craving or biting. Never decide {{user}}'s thoughts, feelings, speech, consent, or choices.
</succubus_companion>
